stories.title: Define Distance Display Schema and Rendering Contract
stories.description: Define how distance is represented in provider result messages, including units (miles), formatting (e.g., '5.2 mi'), rounding rules, and optional presence when distance is unavailable.

stories.title: Implement Distance Rendering in MessageBubble
stories.description: Extend MessageBubble component to display distance alongside provider results, ensuring consistent placement, styling, and readability within chat responses.

stories.title: Integrate Distance Data from Backend into Chat UI
stories.description: Update frontend data handling in ChatWindow to consume distance values returned from backend provider search and ensure they are correctly passed into MessageBubble for rendering.

stories.title: Add Unit and UI Tests for Distance Display
stories.description: Create tests validating correct rendering of distance values, formatting rules, rounding behavior, and handling of missing or null distance data in provider results.

stories.title: Implement Distance Formatting and Fallback Logic
stories.description: Implement frontend logic to normalize raw distance values into user-friendly strings (e.g., rounding, unit suffix) and gracefully handle missing or invalid values (e.g., hide or show 'distance unavailable').
